items.raw_excerpt: 甲骨文“AI二道贩子”的游戏，好像玩不转了。 本月初，一则裁员3万人的传闻，彻底撕开了甲骨文的财务窘境。 据 TD Cowen 发布的专项分析研报称，由于AI数据中心扩建面临融资困境，甲骨文正陷入严峻的资金压力，考虑近期裁员2-3万人来释放80-100亿的现金流。 而这份经营端压力，早已在公司股价走势上显露无遗。 过去一年， 这家闯荡科技圈40余年的老牌巨头上演了一场惊心动魄的“股价过山车”：年初阶梯式冲高，9月10日股价单日暴涨35%至328.33美元，市值一举登顶9222.24亿美元，然而随即遭遇断崖式下跌，截至发稿，股价较最高点跌幅已超50%，市值同样腰斩。 明明锚定云+AI基建转型方向的甲骨文，精准踩中AI算力刚需的核心风口，为何高歌猛进的股价会突然急刹？股价反转的背后，为何这家近乎孤注一掷豪赌AI的老牌巨头，在AGI时代为何无法成为掌握话语权的庄家？ 01.  Al l in AI，甲骨文股价坐上过山车 “甲骨文对AI的押注可以说是背水一战。错过了云计算机遇的它，再也不能错过AI这趟车了。”某机构分析师沈越表示。 作为全球企业级数据库领域的绝对霸主，甲骨文的核心业务长期占据全球近45%的市场份额，在金融、政务等关键领域客户壁垒高筑，ERP、CRM等企业软件也持续贡献稳定营收。 但随着云计算时代的全面到来，其安身立命的数据库业务成为云厂商的核心争夺赛道，AWS、Azure 等头部玩家凭借云上数据库产品，持续蚕食甲骨文的传统基本盘。 这家老牌巨头的云转型也因此陷入阵痛：其OCI（Oracle Cloud Infrastructure）业务虽已早早布局，市场份额却长期徘徊在个位数区间，始终未能跻身第一梯队 。更多甲骨文云转型的曲折故事，欢迎添加作者微信 IHAVEAPLANB- 交流探讨。 全球云服务商市场份额排名 图片来源：Visual Capitalist

excerpt_i18n.en: Oracle's game of being an "AI middleman" seems to be faltering. Earlier this month, rumors of laying off 30,000 employees completely exposed Oracle's financial difficulties. According to a special analysis report released by TD Cowen, due to financing challenges in expanding AI data centers, Oracle is facing severe funding pressure and is considering laying off 20,000 to 30,000 employees in the near term to free up 8 to 10 billion dollars in cash flow. This operational pressure has long been evident in the company's stock price performance. However, it then suffered a cliff-like drop. As of this writing, the stock price has fallen by over 50% from its peak, with its market capitalization also halved. Oracle, which has clearly anchored its transformation direction in cloud + AI infrastructure and precisely caught the core wave of AI computing demand, why did its soaring stock price suddenly brake hard? excerpt_i18n.es: El juego de Oracle como "revendedor de IA" parece estar llegando a su fin. A principios de este mes, un rumor sobre despidos de 30.000 empleados expuso completamente las dificultades financieras de Oracle. Según un informe de análisis especializado publicado por TD Cowen, debido a problemas de financiación en la expansión de centros de datos de IA, Oracle enfrenta una severa presión financiera y está considerando despedir entre 20.000 y 30.000 empleados en el corto plazo para liberar un flujo de efectivo de 8.000 a 10.000 millones de dólares. Esta presión operativa ya se reflejaba claramente en la tendencia del precio de sus acciones. excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Hu Jiaming  Editors: Dong Zibo, Lin Juemin  
On the afternoon of February 2, independent developer and founder of AI gaming company AutoGame, Zhang Haoyang, received a startling email that read: "If you donate $1,000 to this project, we will investigate this matter for you now."  
It all began with Zhang Haoyang’s plugin "Capability Evolver," which he published on OpenClaw. Having just started using OpenClaw two days prior, Zhang had manually developed a self-evolving engine for AI Agents. It could identify improvements in Agents and enable them to break through the limitations of "local optima" through random "mutations."  
Within less than a day of its release on Clawhub, the plugin’s core code garnered over 17,000 downloads and consistently ranked first on the platform’s trending chart.  
However, a day later, the plugin was inexplicably and suddenly removed from the platform.  
After the plugin was taken down, Zhang Haoyang emailed OpenClaw’s author, Peter Steinberger, to inquire about the reason for the removal and how to cooperate to have the plugin reinstated.  
The official response, however, was the "bribery letter" mentioned at the beginning of the article—which truly shocked Zhang Haoyang.

Todo comenzó con el complemento "Capability Evolver" que Zhang Haoyang publicó en OpenClaw.
